Perfect! Now I have gathered comprehensive information about the project-level build configuration. Let me create a detailed report:

## Project Build Configuration and Module Structure Report

I've completed a thorough exploration of the integrated-search project's build configuration. Here's my comprehensive analysis:

### 1. Root Build Configuration (`/Users/admin/project/integrated-search/build.gradle.kts`)

**Key Configuration Details:**
- **Java Version:** Java 21 (via `JavaLanguageVersion.of(21)`)
- **Kotlin Version:** 1.9.25 with Spring plugin 1.9.25
- **Spring Boot:** 3.5.7 with dependency management
- **Gradle Version:** 8.14 (from gradle-wrapper.properties)

**Global Dependencies (Managed via `dependencyManagement`):**
- **Coroutines:** kotlinx-coroutines-core:1.9.0
- **Elasticsearch Client:** 8.13.4
- **Kotest:** 5.9.1 (test framework)
- **Protocol Buffers:** protobuf-kotlin:4.30.2, grpc-kotlin-stub:1.4.3
- **Kafka/Confluent:** kafka-avro-serializer:8.1.1, kafka-json-schema-serializer:8.1.1
- **Serialization:** kotlinx-serialization-json:1.10.0
- **Caching:** caffeine:3.2.3
- **Jackson:** jackson-datatype-jsr310:2.20.1

**Test Framework Setup:**
- Uses JUnit Platform with `useJUnitPlatform()` configured globally
- Kotest extensions for Spring and Testcontainers support

**Build Directory Structure:**
- Centralized build directory under root `/build/{module-path}`
- Unique JAR naming based on project path to avoid conflicts

### 2. Module Dependency Graph Structure

The project follows a **layered hexagonal architecture** with the following core structure:

```
Root Project
├── shared/              (Shared utilities, no test deps)
├── common/              (Common configurations - empty)
├── domain/              (Domain models)
│   ├── cdc/             (CDC schema registry integration with Avro)
│   ├── index/           (Index domain)
│   ├── search/          (Search domain) - HAS TESTS
│   ├── keyword/         (Keyword domain - empty)
│   └── proxy/           (Proxy domain - empty)
├── application/         (Application layer - no direct tests)
│   ├── index/
│   └── search/
├── inbound-adapter/     (REST/Kafka ingress)
│   ├── handler/         (Kafka event handler - no tests)
│   └── rest-api/        (REST API - no tests)
├── outbound-adapter/    (External integrations)
│   ├── legacy/          (Legacy sync - NO TEST DEPS)
│   ├── index/           (Index adapter - NO TEST DEPS)
│   ├── proxy/           (Proxy adapter - HAS TESTS)
│   ├── search/          (Search adapter - NO TEST DEPS)
│   └── keyword/         (Keyword adapter - HAS TESTS)
├── outbound/            (External clients/repositories)
│   ├── client/
│   │   ├── legacy-api/  (NO TEST DEPS)
│   │   ├── proxy-api/   (HAS TESTS)
│   │   └── keyword-analyzer/  (HAS TESTS)
│   └── repository/
│       ├── elasticsearch/  (NO TEST DEPS)
│       └── cache/          (HAS TESTS)
└── bootstrap/           (Runnable applications)
    ├── legacy-sync/     (Legacy sync service - NO TESTS)
    ├── search-api/      (Search API service - NO TESTS)
    └── dynamic-indexer/ (Indexer service - NO TESTS)
```

### 3. Test Dependencies Overview by Module

**Common Test Dependency Pattern:**
```kotlin
testImplementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-test")
testImplementation("io.kotest:kotest-runner-junit5-jvm")
testImplementation("io.kotest:kotest-assertions-core-jvm")
testImplementation("io.kotest.extensions:kotest-extensions-spring")
```

**Modules with Tests:**
- `shared/` - Basic tests (SerializableEntityTest, GlobalExceptionAdviceTest)
- `domain/search/` - Domain tests
- `outbound-adapter/proxy/` - Adapter tests
- `outbound-adapter/keyword/` - Uses direct kotest dependencies (5.9.1 hardcoded)
- `outbound/client/proxy-api/` - Client tests + GraphQL
- `outbound/client/keyword-analyzer/` - Keyword analysis tests
- `outbound/repository/cache/` - Redis cache tests + mockk:1.13.13
- `application/index/` - Application layer tests (via shared)

**Modules WITHOUT Tests:**
- `outbound-adapter/legacy/` - **KEY TARGET** (only spring-boot-starter-webflux)
- `outbound-adapter/index/` - No test deps
- `outbound-adapter/search/` - No test deps
- `outbound/client/legacy-api/` - No test deps
- `outbound/repository/elasticsearch/` - No test deps
- `inbound-adapter/*` - No test deps
- `bootstrap/*` - No test deps

### 4. Special Configurations

**Shared Module (`/Users/admin/project/integrated-search/shared/build.gradle.kts`):**
- gRPC + Protocol Buffers setup
- Custom protobuf source sets configured
- Kotlin source directories configured for generated proto files
- gRPC uses Spring GrPC integration with Reactor patterns

**Domain/CDC Module:**
- Kafka Schema Registry integration
- Avro code generation from schema registry
- CI environment detection to skip schema downloads
- Default schema URL: http://10.90.89.39:8081

**Gradle Wrapper Configuration:**
- Gradle 8.14-bin
- Optimizations commented out (caching, parallel builds disabled by default)

### 5. Test Utilities & Shared Test Infrastructure

**Location:** `/Users/admin/project/integrated-search/tools/cdc-test/`
- Contains test data files for CDC testing
- Sample Kafka messages for catalog and product topics
- Shell scripts for publishing test messages

**Shared Module Test Assets:**
- Located in `shared/src/test/kotlin/com/cowave/shared/`
- Test ErrorCode implementations
- Global exception handling tests

### 6. No JaCoCo Configuration Found

The project currently has **no JaCoCo coverage plugin configured** in any build.gradle.kts files. This is an opportunity area if code coverage metrics are needed.

| Component | Version |
|-----------|---------|
| Gradle | 8.14 |
| Java/JVM | 21 |
| Kotlin | 1.9.25 |
| Spring Boot | 3.5.7 |
| Spring GrPC | 0.12.0 |

| gRPC | 1.4.3 (grpc-kotlin) |
| Protobuf | 4.30.2 |
